description: Check EQL syntax and get the estimated cost of activating a query. Free. tweetAccounts lists the X account behind each tweet condition: billing=per_post accounts cost creditsPerPost for every post from the account (not replies or reposts), matched or not, while the query runs, on top of estimatedCredits. Pass either an inline query or a draftId. method=symbol instead checks that a symbol has market data on a venue, which price and ta conditions need.

description.description: Description to validate with the query.

draftId.description: Validate a stored draft instead of an inline query.

method.description: query validates EQL, symbol checks symbol support.

query.description: EQL query as a JSON object, not a string, with conditions, actions and expiresIn. auto_build drafts one inside its response text. Actions are notify or webhook: a query carrying a credential, such as a telegram_bot botToken or a webhook signingSecret, is refused.

title.description: Title to validate with the query.
